structured.approach: I used the frontend-steps FE-03 procedure. First I read feat.tasks (TSK-07), feat.design (B4 LLD, CT-1, DD-5, DD-8) and task.repo_access in full. From feat.stories, feat.prd and feat.trd I searched only the STORY-07, AC-19 to AC-21 and IF-7 / T-12 to T-16 parts. Then I read the existing ap_portal code: the index.js and test views, ci.mjs, package.json and README. I asked codegraph which code depends on the existing exports. From that I listed the smallest set of changes: two constants, three private helpers and one exported function, all appended in index.js. Two existing lines change (VERSION and module.exports), plus the package.json version and new tests. There are no new files and no edits to existing logic. A verifier subagent checked the draft against its sources. I fixed one citation and one overreach it found, and marked the codegraph test-coverage remark as agent judgement. A shell check was blocked by the step's G9 guardrail, so I read the files with Read and Glob instead.

claims.text: ap_portal has one view-helper module, src/ap_portal/index.js. It exports VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary, with VERSION = '2.3.0'.
formatAmount uses Number(value || 0).toFixed(2), a binary-float path that conflicts with D-2026-044. renderOverdueRisk must not reuse it.
CI compiles every .js file in src/ap_portal and runs node --test with NODE_PATH src. It requires line coverage >= 90, no console.log or eval( lines, and lines of at most 140 characters.

The components to add in index.js are RISK_CLASSES, OVERDUE_HEADINGS, the private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass, and the exported renderOverdueRisk. module.exports gains renderOverdueRisk.
TSK-07's file budget is src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js. LABELS, formatAmount, renderAgingSummary and their tests must not change.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for missing, null or [] rows. It throws TypeError for non-array rows, for a non-decimal-string amount and for a non-integer days value. It escapes id and vendor, and an unknown risk value gets the class risk-unknown.
The new code goes between renderAgingSummary (ends at line 13) and module.exports (line 15). Of the existing lines, only VERSION (line 3) and module.exports (line 15) change.
VERSION in index.js and "version" in package.json must move together as one minor version step. The lane confirms the number.

open_questions: CMQ-1 (non-blocking): Where are the overdue-risk and risk-* classes styled? ap_portal has no stylesheet and no input names a host page (related to DQ-1). Interim answer: TSK-07 only emits the classes.
CMQ-2 (non-blocking): Which exact version number should the minor step use? Interim answer: the lane confirms it at FE-04.
Carried, non-blocking: TQ-2, TQ-6, TQ-7, TQ-11/OQ-B10, OQ-B8, OQ-B9/PQ-P7, DQ-3, RAQ-1 (branch feature/story).
structured.summary: I wrote task.components for TSK-07 / STORY-07 in ap_portal. The change stays in TSK-07's three budgeted files and adds no new files. In src/ap_portal/index.js, two constants, three private helpers and the exported renderOverdueRisk are appended after renderAgingSummary. The only existing lines that change are VERSION and module.exports. package.json changes its version only, and tests/portal.test.js gets new tests covering every TypeError and empty-input branch so CI's 90% line-coverage bar holds. LABELS, formatAmount, renderAgingSummary and their tests stay unchanged. There are no blocking questions.

tool_input.command: git ls-files && cat package.json ci.mjs && wc -l src/ap_portal/index.js tests/portal.test.js
tool_input.description: List repo files and show package.json and CI script
